description: Change SG-Ready: mode 1..4 (immediate; mode 1 ends automatically after limit_min), enabled, k1 / k2 (output ids: relay 1.. or PCA 2001..; 0 = none; K1 and K2 must differ), limit_min 1..120. Mode is a state change (MYIO_WRITE=state); the others are configuration. Saved immediately (EEPROM).
name: myio_sgready_set
title: Set SG-Ready
